card.name: Chloramine and other name endings
card.fires_on: The last piece of the word chloramine, mainly in water-treatment text. It also fires on the final piece of some proper names, such as Holly, Harold, Lhotse and Bloomsbury, and on digits inside a number.

modes.label: Digits in numbers
